detailed_descriptions.en: Jumpscare your friends! 2-8+ players. If you write your friend's name on a page, the monster jumpscares them and they scream. Co-op comedy horror where you and your friends are trapped in a haunted neighborhood house. Can you reach the exit together, or will you scare each other out? Use a Scream Note on a friend by writing their username - and the monster carries it out. They get jumpscared. And they'll scream, guaranteed. The only true friendship test game on Steam. 2-8+ players. Work with your friends to escape the haunted house together ... If you can manage to cooperate and not jumpscare each other out. You climb the haunted house to search for the exit, but you end up finding cursed pages left by the demons who don't want you out. Over 222+ unique jumpscares, each one crazier than the last. Really, we put the craziest & most unexpected jumpscares in this game, even ones that reach into your PC (optional). You'll all decide that you want to try to reach the exit together tonight, but at the last moment someone will pull a jumpscare ruining everything, and you'll be falling off a bridge 5 floors down. This game was specifically designed so when you use a Scream Note on your friend, they scream. Not a fake streamer horror scream, I mean, they are really, going to scream, guaranteed - more than any other game on Steam. The jumpscares don't rely on horror. They rely on your friend being the one who just made you lose your spot from the exit. Streamer mode included (1-8 players, viewers jumpscare you with twitch points / donations / subs / bits). Triples your average stream revenue based on real-streamers data.
